How the two search modes differ

Both answer questions about your people. They differ in how much they first dig into your data, and therefore in cost.

Standard · ~35k tokens · the everyday default

Reads a one-line summary of every household — names, Prospect score, home value, total giving — plus it searches your notes for whatever is relevant. Good for “who mentioned wanting to host a Shabbos dinner?”, where the answer is in a note.

Power Search · ~80–100k tokens · slow & costly (~$0.20)

Reads the full profile of every household: score breakdown, giving history, research, business background, plus your notes. For big jobs like “build me a major-gift list with talking points.” It asks before running.

If you’re not sure, use Standard.
